title: Origins: Mime
description: An Origin that can place Invisible Blocks
body:
# Mime
_"Conjurer of invisible walls, silent magician, tragic illusionist. Pantomimus."_

`Made for Forge, Minecraft version 1.20.1, Origins version 1.10.2), Impact: 1, Icon: Glass`

### "Invisible Act":
- [Primary Active Ability, Toggle On/Off with Default keybind = G]
- [+] You can conjure up invisible blocks that only you can see.
- [+] Both your hands need to be empty for you to use your Mime Magic
- [+] Type \"/trigger FrucsMimeTimeLimit set InsertValueHere\" in chat to set the expiry timer for all Mime Blocks.\nIt's 600 seconds by Default
- [+] These blocks are invisible, and can be broken instantly by any player.

### "The Fourth Wall":
- [Secondary Active Ability, Toggle On/Off with Default keybind = Unbound]
- [+] You can toggle between phasing through Invisible Blocks or not
- [+] This will also toggle the invisible blocks' hitboxes being visible (F3 + B)
- [+] The invisible blocks will always be invisible for other players. They cannot even see their hitboxes...

### "Final Act":
- [Third Active Ability, Default keybind = C or "Save Hotbar Activator".key]
- [+] Your invisible blocks vanish into thin air! Hold Key for 2 seconds.
- [+] This destroys any invisible blocks placed by any Mime (that are currently loaded)

### "Thin Air Performance":
- [Passives]
- [+] +30 percent movement speed.
- [+] After defeating the Dragon, you unlock a new power...
<details>
<summary>Spoilers</summary>
Toggleable On/Off with Invisible Act

You learn to place invisible blocks underneath you and jump off of them in midair. This will however not save you if you're falling
</details>

### "Drawbacks":
- [Negative Passives]
- [-] Take 2x fire damage and lose 10 percent more hunger

_Origin by Frucs_
